articles.title: United 757 declares Mayday after low‑fuel go‑around at San Francisco International Airport
articles.summary: A United Airlines Boeing 757 on flight UA1023 from Boston to San Francisco aborted its landing due to an unstable approach, later reporting a fuel emergency with just over 5,000 lb remaining before landing safely.

sources.title: United Boeing 757 Declares Mayday As Fuel Runs Low After Aborted Landing At San Francisco

articles.title: Helicopter Pilot Compensation Remains Unclear Compared to Airline Counterparts, According to BLS Data
articles.summary: Simple Flying notes that the Bureau of Labor Statistics aggregates helicopter pilots with other commercial pilots, making direct salary comparisons with airline pilots speculative.

sources.title: How Much Do Helicopter Pilots Earn Compared To Airline Pilots In 2026?

articles.title: Delta Becomes Only U.S. Airline Flying Airbus’ Latest Wide‑Body Jets
articles.summary: Delta’s long‑haul fleet now centers on the A350 and A330neo, a position its domestic rivals have abandoned, according to Simple Flying.

sources.title: Fleet Strategy: How Delta Air Lines Became The Only US Carrier Operating Airbus' Newest Widebodies
